authority: Root review, 20 October 2026, before any E1 production analysis
additional_forced_flag: The sigma-one abnormal majority remains the same abnormal majority at both sigma 0.5 and 0.25 and in the exact matched sigma-zero mean control.
low_sigma_persistence: Report separately when the abnormal majority persists at 0.5 and 0.25 without mean-control agreement; this alone is not additional forced-state proof.
healthy_single_front: Never triggers the additional flag merely by persisting as sigma falls.
baseline_mean_union_flag: Independent of the additional E1 flag: matched mean spends more than half the window with R<0.1 or contrast below 0.1 times exact basal contrast.
scope: Observed controls, not an inferred sigma-to-zero limit. No E1 result has been analyzed when this rule is frozen.
